title: Hosted API Model Rollout Communications Playbook
author: Camila Reyes
body:
h1. Purpose
Provide consistent internal and external communication for Hosted API model rollouts, including rollbacks. This playbook prioritizes clarity, speed, and minimizing customer confusion.

h1. Audience
* Internal: #eng-releases, #eng-oncall, #support, #customer-success
* External: status page subscribers, affected customers (email), and enterprise shared channels (if established)

h1. When to communicate
* Routine rollout: internal announcement at start and completion.
* Customer-visible degradation or rollback: internal + customer-facing comms depending on impact and duration.

h1. Internal templates

h2. Rollout start (post in #eng-releases)
Subject: Rollout started: <route>
Body: Driver <name> starting rollout for <route> from <stable_version> to <new_version>. Canary begins at <time>. Dashboard links: <links>.

h2. Ramp step update
Body: <route> now at <percent>% on <new_version>. Gates green so far. Next evaluation at <time>.

h2. Rollout completion
Body: Rollout complete for <route>. New stable: <new_version>. Total duration: <X>. Notes: <any anomalies>.

h2. Rollback notice
Body: Rolled back <route> from <new_version> to <stable_version> at <time> due to <reason>. Customer impact: <yes/no + summary>. Next update in <time>.

h1. Customer comms guidance

h2. Status page criteria
Update the status page if ANY of the following are true:
* customer-facing errors exceed the incident threshold
* widespread latency increase affecting multiple customers
* a rollback occurs after reaching >= 25% traffic

If unsure, consult Platform Oncall + Support lead.

h2. Status page message (degradation)
Title: Increased errors on Hosted API
Body: We are investigating elevated error rates affecting some requests to the Hosted API. We will provide another update within 30 minutes.

h2. Status page message (rollback)
Title: Mitigation applied for Hosted API
Body: We identified a regression during a model rollout and have reverted traffic to the previous stable version. Metrics are recovering. We will continue monitoring.

h2. Customer email (targeted)
Subject: Hosted API service update
Body: We detected an issue during a routine model update that may have impacted request success rate or latency for your workloads between <start> and <end>. We mitigated by reverting to the previous stable configuration. If you observed errors, please share request IDs for investigation.

h1. Do and don’t
* Do state what customers should expect next (next update time).
* Do provide a mitigation statement once applied.
* Don’t mention internal model codenames or unconfirmed root causes.
* Don’t promise exact resolution times unless confident.

h1. Record keeping
The comms owner should link the status page incident and any customer emails back to the rollout tracking ticket.
